A butterfly on a screen can teach a child what it looks like. 🦋
But experiencing one can make them wonder.

What happens when it flies away?
Why are its wings that colour?
Where will it go next?

That’s the difference between simply receiving information and having the freedom to explore it.

In the early years, learning happens through seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, tasting, moving, and experiencing the world around them. 🌱

Because children don’t just learn from what we show them.
They learn from what they get to experience.

At Little Elly, our H.A.P.P.Y. Curriculum gives children opportunities to explore through their senses, their surroundings, and everyday experiences.

Because sometimes, the best way to learn about the world is to experience it. 💛

Confident conversations build stronger partnerships. 💛

Recently, Preeti Ma’am conducted a workshop for our Little Elly Centre Heads and teaching staff on “Parent Conversations with Confidence.”

From understanding how to communicate effectively to navigating conversations with greater clarity and confidence, the session focused on strengthening one of the most important relationships in early childhood education: the partnership between educators and parents.

Because when educators and parents communicate with confidence and understanding, children benefit the most. 🌱

A meaningful session of learning, reflection, and growing together.
